# SiroPHP

> Production-first PHP API framework with built-in debugging, request replay, and testing workflows. Zero dependencies.

SiroPHP lets you scaffold CRUD APIs in seconds (`make:crud`), debug production bugs instantly by replaying captured requests (`api:why` → `replay --diff`), and ship with enterprise quality gates (80% line coverage, Infection MSI ~83%).

## Key facts

- Current version: v0.40.0 (core) / v0.40.0 (skeleton)
- Requires: PHP 8.2+, ext-pdo, ext-json, ext-mbstring
- License: MIT
- Cold boot: ~0.5 ms (Linux) / ~3 ms (Windows); ~300K route dispatches/sec; ~4 MB baseline RAM
- Tests: 406 core tests + 742 skeleton tests passing; 17,851 fuzz checks; 157 DAST security checks

- [API reference](https://sirophp.com/documentation/api): every class and method

- [Blog](https://sirophp.com/blog): tutorials on debugging, replay, CLI testing
